narrative:
Perry County has 22,517 registered voters, with 54.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 14.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.5% of registrants.
